name: metabolismregulation gallery
description: Hand-drawn maps of metabolic regulation; the SBGN map of each is its reference layout (SBGN classes and labels from it too).

name: Inborn metabolic disorders (IMD maps)
description: Escher maps of the pathways of inborn metabolic disorders, drawn by hand on the Recon3D model for the VMH; each map is its reference layout, and its reactions and metabolites are the model. Only maps already online in the VMH (the others are unpublished).

name: Stress Knowledge Map (PSS)
description: Plant stress signalling, from the Stress Knowledge Map (skm.nib.si), with model fixes; public data, Arabidopsis thaliana.

name: BRENDA pathways
description: Pathways of BRENDA's pathway map; the reference is the pathway on that map (BRENDA, CC BY 4.0), read from ecmapper's export of it.

name: Reactome
description: A Reactome pathway; its SBML has Reactome's diagram as an SBML Layout, the reference layout.
